title: BengaliMoralBench: A Benchmark for Auditing Moral Reasoning in Large Language Models within Bengali Language and Culture

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot classification performance (Accuracy, F1, MCC, Kappa) on BengaliMoralBench, a curated dataset of 3,000 moral dilemmas grounded in Bangladeshi socio-cultural norms, and comparing results against Western-centric ethical assumptions.
Comparing model performance on moral reasoning tasks when prompted in Bengali versus English to evaluate cross-lingual generalization and the dominance of English-centric pretraining.

Assessing model accuracy on the 'Religious Activities' domain (e.g., Qurbani distribution, Puja respect) and using qualitative error analysis to detect failures in understanding faith-driven ethical behaviors.

Conducting qualitative error analysis on model misclassifications in 'Family Relationships' scenarios to identify the reproduction of systemic societal biases, such as the unethical prioritization of male family members.
